_description: Single source of truth for Literature paper marks. Every per-paper TOTAL here is cross-checked against the official mark-scheme PDFs (AQA/OCR/Edexcel/Edexcel-iGCSE/Eduqas/CCEA/SQA, June 2024 unless noted). Each entry carries a `split` (the per-section mark allocation the assessment scaffold uses) so the protocol headers, the frontend MARK_SPLITS, and these numbers cannot drift apart. `tools/protocol-consistency-check.js` validates every protocol's section-sum against the `split`/`marks` here. NEVER estimate — confirmed rows reference real mark schemes; anything not yet eyeballed against the official MS carries verified:false + a _verify note.

_shape_enum.lit-extract-single: 1 extract + 1 question (AQA Shakespeare, 19th C; Edexcel; EDUQAS)
_shape_enum.lit-no-extract: 0 extracts + 1 whole-text question (AQA Modern Text, possibly Edexcel IGCSE Modern Drama / Shakespeare)
_shape_enum.poetry-single-named: 1 named anthology poem printed in full + 1 question
_shape_enum.poetry-comparison: Named poem A + student-chosen poem B + 1 comparison question
_shape_enum.poetry-unseen: 1 unseen poem (Q1) or 2 unseen poems (Q2 comparison), printed in full

_schema.marks: integer — total marks for the question (content + SPaG where applicable)
_schema.spag_marks: integer | null — SPaG portion of total marks (AQA Lit papers include AO4 SPaG)
_schema.aos: array of AO codes (e.g. AO1, AO2, AO3, AO4)

split._doc: How the scaffold breaks `marks` into assessable sections. Discriminated by `shape`. Must reconcile with the protocol's section headers + frontend MARK_SPLITS.
split.shape:standard: { shape:'standard', intro, body, body_count, conclusion } — invariant: intro + body*body_count + conclusion === marks
split.shape:custom: { shape:'custom', sections:[{label, marks}, ...] } — multi-question / 2-box / non-TTECEA papers; sections sum to marks
split.shape:holistic: { shape:'holistic', marks } — band-marked whole-piece, no paragraph split (e.g. SQA critical essay)
split.null: split not yet defined (sibling paper with no dedicated protocol, or pending verification)

extract.count: integer — number of extracts/poems printed (1 or 2)
extract.lines_min: integer | null — per-extract minimum content lines
extract.lines_max: integer | null — per-extract maximum content lines
extract.verified: boolean — true only when measured from real past papers
extract.source: string — citation for the range

_schema.question_prefix: string | null — canonical opening phrase (for preamble guidance + parser hint)
